parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the scan task.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description:
The name of the task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: a task of the Security Center agent
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: an O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSET\_SECURITY_CHECK**: a task of asset information collection

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

*   **CLIENT\_PROBLEM_CHECK**: a task of the Security Center agent
*   **CLIENT\_DEV_OPS**: an O\&M task of Cloud Assistant
*   **ASSET\_SECURITY_CHECK**: a task of asset information collection

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-once-task-result-info --task-type ASSETS_COLLECTION --task-name ASSETS_COLLECTION --task-id 9dfa3a7eb9547781632785b490030000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
